reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering flooring, multiplayer marriage, weed variants, wheat products, algae, eggs, and fishing bait were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established glossary and fish names, multiplayer proposal semantics, weed-drop distinctions, crop timing and harvesting, object gender, flooring instructions, and the double-catch effect; both found no remaining objective issue.

WeatheredFloor_Description.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
WeatheredFloor_Description.translation: Așaz-o pe sol pentru a crea poteci sau pentru a-ți înfrumuseța podelele.

WeddingRing_Description.source: An old Zuzu City tradition... It's used to ask for another farmer's hand in marriage.
WeddingRing_Description.translation: O veche tradiție din Orașul Zuzu... Este folosită pentru a cere mâna altui fermier.

Weeds_DryBush_Description.source: A cluster of dry old bushes. Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
Weeds_DryBush_Description.translation: Un pâlc de tufișuri bătrâne și uscate. Poate conține Fibră sau Semințe amestecate.

Weeds_Fiber_Ugly_Description.source: Ugly weeds. Cut to obtain wild seeds.
Weeds_Fiber_Ugly_Description.translation: Buruieni urâte. Taie-le pentru a obține Semințe sălbatice.

Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Description.source: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Description.translation: Pot conține Fibră sau Semințe amestecate.

Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Ugly_Description.source: Ugly weeds. Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Ugly_Description.translation: Buruieni urâte. Pot conține Fibră sau Semințe amestecate.

Wheat_Description.source: One of the most widely cultivated grains. Makes a great flour for breads and cakes.
Wheat_Description.translation: Una dintre cele mai răspândite cereale cultivate. Din ea se obține o făină excelentă pentru pâine și prăjituri.

WheatFlour_Description.source: A common cooking ingredient made from crushed wheat seeds.
WheatFlour_Description.translation: Un ingredient culinar obișnuit, obținut din boabe de grâu măcinate.

WheatSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the summer or fall. Takes 4 days to mature. Harvest with the scythe.
WheatSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le vara sau toamna. Ajung la maturitate în 4 zile. Recoltează-le cu coasa.

WhiteEgg_Description.translation: Un ou alb obișnuit, de găină.

WildBait_Description.source: A unique recipe from Linus that gives you a chance to catch two fish at once.
WildBait_Description.translation: O rețetă unică de la Linus, care îți oferă șansa de a prinde doi pești deodată.
